targets.outcome_quote:
This study replicates the gene-environment inter-
       action of the 5HTT gene variant with church attendance, but not the association with MAOA.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly report that the 5HTT-by-church-attendance association replicated and the MAOA association did not. These are two findings from the same original paper and receive one mixed verdict.

reasoning: The central empirical test uses newly genotyped Wave IV subjects excluded from the original sample to re-test Fowler and Dawes (2008). Specification checks examine the independent replication sample and sometimes the pooled sample; they do not turn the independent replication into a reproduction. Charney and English (2012) supplies the critique and alternative specifications, not another empirical original being retested. Other genetic and twin studies are background.
